replay.note: the advocates' outputs were replayed from an earlier run and not regenerated by this one: only the judge was called, so the figures here measure the judge's behaviour on fixed inputs and not the whole pipeline

discarded_claims.claim: POL-NS-01 limb (b) and the POL-NS-02 proximity test are satisfied. The driver's trace holds 23 consecutive fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, sitting 18.1 m to 29.3 m from the pickup pin at 6.1 m to 11.9 m reported accuracy, well inside the 25 m accuracy filter, running from 12:30:00. The first in-geofence fix is five seconds from the 12:29:55 arrival marker and the derived dwell_start_offset_sec is -5.0 s; there is no clock-skew finding here and POL-NS-08(a) would require more than 90 seconds before that match could be called unsafe.
discarded_claims.reason: Cites EV-GPS-00211, whose weight_multiplier is 0.39 (issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE), without disclosing the impairment or naming the issue codes. Discarded under POL-GEN-02(1).

discarded_claims.claim: The 'arrived' marker at 12:29:55 is not a false arrival under POL-NS-05, so the waiting clock runs from the marker as recorded and needs no recomputation. At the marker the driver's device reported 18.1 m from the pin - far inside the 50 m STANDARD radius, nowhere near the 300 m distance trigger - and the trace reports a 0.0 km/h speed alongside his stationary kerbside hold, so the 15 km/h motion trigger is not met either. Limb (iii) of POL-NS-05 applies: the marker is genuine, and it does not defeat the fee.
discarded_claims.reason: Cites EV-GPS-00211, whose weight_multiplier is 0.39 (issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE), without disclosing the impairment or naming the issue codes. Discarded under POL-GEN-02(1).

discarded_claims.claim: The 500 s longest_qualifying_run figure cannot be used to satisfy the dwell: it is a span drawn across the outage, not a demonstrated presence through it. Its fix_count of 35 is exactly the sum of the two split runs' 23 and 12 fixes, so not one fix inside 12:33:40-12:36:28 places the driver in the geofence. Reading the presence as a single 500 s run, or as an accumulated 332 s, is reachable only by adding the two intervals together - which is what POL-NS-06(i) permits solely where a present and populated traffic_advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covers the pickup road. EV-ADVIS-00211-01 is MISSING and carries weight 0.0, so limb (i) is unavailable, the separate intervals may not be summed and the gap may not be bridged. I cite that artifact only for its absence, as POL-GEN-02 permits.
discarded_claims.reason: Cites EV-GPS-00211, whose weight_multiplier is 0.39 (issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE), without stating that the artifact is impaired or naming the issue codes; it discloses only the absence of EV-ADVIS-00211-01. Discarded under POL-GEN-02(1).

discarded_claims.claim: The driver's 12:35:10 message, 'boss still here waiting ah, cannot see you', shows he was still working the pickup during the outage, but it is his own unsworn assertion and carries no coordinates. POL-NS-01(c) requires the gps_trace to hold the driver inside the geofence for the dwell, and the chat log records nothing about position; a chat message cannot bridge a 168 second trace gap that the trace itself cannot bridge, and it is in any event a statement about his own conduct rather than a fix. The chat log is otherwise clean - five entries, matching trip_record.chat_message_count of 5, weight 1.0 - so the driver has no chat-side defect to complain of either.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties, here is what I have decided and why.

THE FEE STANDS AND THE DRIVER IS COMPENSATED. The $4.00 cancellation fee is chargeable, and $3.20 of it is paid to the driver.

The tested conditions. POL-NS-01 requires four things, and three are not really in dispute. The trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 12:29:55, shows no boarding and shows the trip terminated by the driver at 12:38:20 on the reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW - limbs (a) and (d). The GPS trace places him 18.1 to 29.3 m from the pin, inside the 50 m STANDARD radius, at 6.1 to 11.9 m reported accuracy, which is the POL-NS-02 proximity test; and at the arrival marker he was stationary and metres away, not 300 m out and not moving at 15 km/h, so POL-NS-05 does not make the marker false.

The fourth condition - limb (c), a continuous 300-second in-geofence dwell - is the whole argument, and the rider is right about two things. The trace has a 168-second hole from 12:33:40 to 12:36:28, and under POL-NS-06(i) the two in-geofence runs that hole creates (220 s and 112 s) cannot simply be added together, because the traffic advisory that limb requires is absent. But the hole does not have to be filled by that trace. Chat message MSG-00211-004, 'boss still here waiting ah, cannot see you', was sent at 12:35:10 - from inside the hole - and is a contemporaneous record made from within the very stretch the trace leaves unobserved, lying between fixes the trace admitted on both sides of it, and coming from a different source. It therefore counts, and it means the impaired trace is not the only evidence of what was happening in those 168 seconds. Taken together - in-geofence fixes before the hole, the driver's own message from inside it, in-geofence fixes after it - the driver held the pickup continuously from 12:30:00 to 12:38:20, 500 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum. Limb (c) is met, and POL-NS-06 has no shortfall to refund. The rider's 'coming down now, 2 min' at 12:31:02, followed by silence until 12:38:45, is why the driver's account is the credible one.

THE IMPAIRMENT AND CONFIDENCE. I have not treated the GPS trace as clean. EV-GPS-00211 is impaired, weight 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE, and on its own it cannot prove the dwell across the hole. It does not have to: the independent chat record carries the same fact, so the discounted trace neither caps my confidence below the platform floor nor makes this a case in which an impaired artifact is the only evidence. The driver's suggestion that the case must therefore escalate is not correct.

THE OTHER POINTS. The rider is not exonerated under POL-NS-04: the driver replied at 12:31:20, eighteen seconds after her message and well inside the 120-second window limb (b) requires. Her own presence at the pickup, which her trace supports, does not change this, because POL-NS-06 refunds only where the waiting period fell short and it did not. EV-ADVIS-00211-01 is absent and carries weight 0.0; it is cited only for its absence and no finding rests on it.

COMPENSATION. POL-NS-07 pays 80% of the $4.00 fee, which is $3.20, and the anti-farming check does not withhold it: 2 no-show terminations in 30 days is below the 4 required, and 2 out of 146 completed trips is 1.4%, below 8%. The remaining $0.80 is retained as the platform service fee. Because this ruling moves money to the driver, amount_sgd carries the same $3.20 figure as driver_compensation_sgd - it is not a refund to the rider, and the $4.00 charge stays exactly where it is.
